scope: SYNTHETIC report-format demonstration. No actual FHIR resource was reviewed.
summary: Illustrates one correction and one missing-example suggestion in a paired report. These are not findings about FHIR.
limitations: Synthetic input tests report structure and rendering, not reviewer accuracy or FHIR conformance.

inventory.note: One synthetic example. Its status is missing.
Synthetic module discusses completed and cancelled events.

findings.title: Required status is absent (synthetic)
findings.evidence: The synthetic definition requires status; the synthetic example omits it.
findings.proposed_change: Add the status that accurately represents this example's lifecycle.
findings.replacement:
Owner decision required: choose the supported status for the intended lifecycle.
Do not infer that a missing status means completed.
findings.rationale: The example should demonstrate the declared structural contract.
findings.validation: Check cardinality, allowed value, and narrative agreement after the owner supplies intent.

findings.title: Cancelled-event example (synthetic)
findings.evidence: The synthetic module discusses cancellation, but the fixture includes no cancelled scenario.
findings.proposed_change: Consider adding a focused cancelled-event example and link it from the module.
findings.replacement: Minimum content: supported cancelled status, coherent subject and dates, and matching narrative. Use only fields supported by the synthetic definition.
findings.rationale: This would illustrate the module's lifecycle distinction.
findings.validation: Validate supported fields and compare the scenario with the module text.
findings.decision: Optional editorial improvement; not a normative requirement.

acceptance: Resolve the synthetic owner decision before selecting a replacement status.
